selection.topic: 为什么AI骗局里还要故意混进真人？

canonical_signal_cluster.event: Anthropic September 2026 threat-intelligence report / deceptive dating app network
canonical_signal_cluster.freshness: published 2026-09-10; still receiving fresh secondary coverage in the last week
verified_facts: Anthropic says a China-based app studio operated more than 20 deceptive dating apps.
Anthropic reports more than 4,700 AI personas interacted with at least 25,000 people in a two-week April 2026 window.
The feed was approximately 75% AI personas and 25% real people.
Real workers handled authenticity bottlenecks such as live video calls and social-media follow-backs while AI handled conversation at scale.
Anthropic says it banned the attributed accounts and organizations.
canonical_signal_cluster.cluster_note: Multiple reports about the dating-app case are treated as one canonical event, not separate signals.

candidate_gates.human_relevance: PASS — users can directly understand the risk of believing they are interacting with a real person.
candidate_gates.mechanism_integrity: PASS — hybrid human+AI systems can allocate repetitive scalable interaction to AI and scarce authenticity checks to humans.
candidate_gates.one_mechanism: PASS — focus only on division of labor between scalable AI personas and human authenticity bottlenecks.
candidate_gates.storyability: PASS — apparent relationship → suspicion → real-person verification → restored trust → reveal that the human was only one component of a larger automated system.
candidate_gates.non_trivial_payoff: PASS — the important change is not simply that AI can impersonate people, but that a small amount of genuine human interaction can make a mostly automated system appear fully human.
candidate_gates.audience_fit: PASS — durable AI mental model translated through an immediately legible human situation.

duplicate_gates.D1_signal: PASS — clustered Anthropic report and derivative coverage into one event.
duplicate_gates.D2_topic: PASS — no registry topic has hybrid human+AI authenticity bottleneck as mechanism + problem + payoff.
duplicate_gates.D3_angle: PASS — distinct from agent permission/control and hallucination/search topics already scheduled.
duplicate_gates.D4_story_visual_motif: PASS_WITH_WATCH — external real case differs from current office/secretary/desk motifs; avoid reusing boss/assistant framing.
